subject.title: chore(deps): bump github.com/steipete/commander from 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 in /apps/swabble in the swift-deps group across 1 directory

question: Should the native-app dependency graph remain on Commander 0.2.2 until every exact requirement and resolution can move together, or should maintainers coordinate an atomic 0.2.3 graph update now?
rationale: The isolated version bump is not independently merge-safe because SwiftPM must reconcile the shared package identity across the combined native-app graph, and choosing when to move the graph depends on upstream-release and app-integration intent.

options.title: Keep the graph on 0.2.2
options.body: Close or pause this isolated bump until all native-app Commander requirements and resolutions have compatible 0.2.3 releases and can update together.

options.title: Coordinate an atomic 0.2.3 update
options.body: Update every exact Commander requirement and affected resolution in one reviewed change with macOS, iOS, and Swabble command proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the graph on 0.2.2
recommendation.body: Close or pause this isolated bump until all native-app Commander requirements and resolutions have compatible 0.2.3 releases and can update together.
